title: Machine learning and genetic search design antimicrobial peptides
summary: Regression and k-nearest-neighbor models with a genetic algorithm guided optimization from a shrimp lipopolysaccharide-binding peptide to LBD_A–D. The article reports in-vitro tests, NMR structure for LBD_B and improved survival in a kuruma prawn co-injection experiment. This is not human therapy and does not establish treatment efficacy after infection.
ai_technology: Regression and k-nearest-neighbor models; genetic algorithm

evidence.tested: Article reports synthesized/tested peptide variants, NMR characterization and a prawn co-injection assay.
evidence.unknown: Full exact assay/organism scope and peptide sequence novelty/independent replication not exhaustively compared.
evidence.ai_role: Activity models and genetic search guided sequence variants which were synthesized and biologically tested.

source_review.scope: Primary source checked for identity, date, model role and bounded reported result.
